items.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
items.summary: Amazon has launched a new dev tool called TorchNeuron to challenge Nvidia's dominance in the PyTorch ecosystem. The tool aims to encourage developers to utilize alternative chips instead of Nvidia hardware.
items.blurb: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

items.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
items.summary: Hackers have compromised the open-source AI coding tool OpenCode, leading to unauthorized charges on user accounts. The breach involved stolen API keys and difficulties in detecting the malicious code.
items.blurb: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

items.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
items.summary: AI companion app Tolan has successfully raised $30 million in new funding. The app has reached a milestone of over 250,000 active users.
items.blurb: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

items.title: Sony’s best noise-canceling earbuds are nearly $100 off today only
items.summary: Sony's latest WF-1000XM6 noise-canceling earbuds are available at an all-time low price of $238 at B&H Photo. This limited-time deal makes the new model cheaper than the previous version.
items.blurb: For a very limited time, Sony’s latest high-end noise-canceling earbuds are actually cheaper than their last-gen counterpart, the WF-1000XM5. B&H Photo is selling Sony’s latest WF-1000XM6 in black for an all-time low of $238 ($92 off) at checkout. Other retailers aren’t currently offering a discount on the XM6. The XM6 are a solid upgrade over […]

items.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
items.summary: Replika founder Eugenia Kuyda has launched a new startup called Wabi. The company provides a personal AI assistant that is now available for public download.
items.blurb: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

items.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
items.summary: Tenstorrent has reached a $6.2 billion valuation after raising $1.5 billion in funding. The company, which builds open-weight AI chips, aims to maintain its independence.
items.blurb: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.

items.title: Here's how we would build out the perfect modular electric Slate truck
items.summary: Designers explore concepts for a modular electric truck titled the Slate. The vehicle is envisioned as a modernized version of the classic Bronco.
items.blurb: A Bronco for the modern age.

items.title: We might finally know what's written on that mysterious plaque in Super Mario 64
items.summary: A long-standing mystery regarding a plaque in the game Super Mario 64 may finally be solved. The message has intrigued internet users for three decades.
items.blurb: The plaque's message has haunted the internet for 30 years.

items.title: AI assistant startup Town nabs unicorn valuation four months after launch
items.summary: The AI assistant startup Town has achieved a unicorn valuation following a $108 million Series B funding round. The investment was co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures.
items.blurb: AI assistant startup Town nabbed a unicorn valuation on Monday, announcing a $108 million Series B round co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures.

items.title: Is paid antivirus actually a waste of money for your PC in 2026?
items.summary: This article discusses whether paid antivirus software remains a necessary expense for modern PC users. It suggests that such suites are significantly less useful today than they were in the past.
items.blurb: Subscribing to an antivirus suite kept you safe a long time ago, but they're much less useful for most people today.

items.title: Rivian’s CEO says autonomy will enable ‘dramatically different’ vehicle designs
items.summary: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe believes that autonomous technology will fundamentally change the design of future vehicles. This shift could lead the company to develop models beyond its current SUV and truck lineup.
items.blurb: Founder and CEO RJ Scaringe said he thinks autonomy will allow his company to build radically different kinds of vehicles than the outdoorsy SUVs and trucks it currently makes.

items.title: Homeland Security bans DeepSeek use in federal civilian agencies
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security has prohibited the use of DeepSeek within federal civilian agencies. The ban follows the recent release of the latest AI model from DeepSeek.
items.blurb: The decision comes a couple of days after the release of Deepseek's latest AI model.

items.title: Amazon to fund 12 small nuclear reactors at former Indiana coal plant
items.summary: Amazon has partnered with X-energy to fund 12 small modular nuclear reactors at a former coal site in Indiana. This project is expected to generate nearly 1 gigawatt of electricity for the power grid.
items.blurb: Amazon and X-energy have inked another deal to deploy nuclear power to the grid. This one will generate nearly 1 gigawatt of electricity.

items.title: At what distance does a video doorbell stop detecting motion?
items.summary: Video doorbells may fail to send motion alerts for several reasons beyond just distance. Various environmental and technical factors can impact the device's detection capabilities.
items.blurb: Your video doorbell might see a visitor without sending an alert. Detection depends on more than distance, and some surprising factors can affect its reach.

items.title: Fiber vs. cable internet: What's the difference between them?
items.summary: The article compares fiber and cable internet technologies. While fiber is considered more modern, cable remains a capable solution for current connectivity needs.
items.blurb: Fiber internet is more modern than cable, but the older technology still works well for today's connection needs.

items.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
items.summary: Smart TV owners are increasingly using AI agents to remove intrusive ads and bloatware from their devices. This trend reflects growing frustration with the complexity and tracking features of modern smart TV interfaces.
items.blurb: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

items.title: Apple is set to hold another product event on October 28
items.summary: Apple has scheduled a product event for October 28 in Los Angeles. The event is expected to feature a new touchscreen Mac.
items.blurb: Apple's "Pro and Tell" event is taking place in Los Angeles and will likely feature the first touchscreen Mac.

items.title: Apple teases MacBook Pro event next week
items.summary: Apple has announced an event for October 28th to reveal new hardware. Expected products include updated Macs and a refreshed iPad Mini, with a new OLED MacBook Pro being the rumored headline.
items.blurb: Apple has sent invites to a second product launch this month, and it's scheduled for October 28th at 1PM ET in Los Angeles. At the event, Apple is set to announce new Macs and a refreshed iPad Mini, according to Bloomberg. The big announcement is expected to be a new MacBook Pro with an OLED […]

items.title: Why your USB device keeps disconnecting (and how to fix it)
items.summary: This guide provides troubleshooting steps for resolving persistent USB connection issues. It suggests focusing on the physical ports as part of the diagnosis process.
items.blurb: If your USB peripheral is on the fritz, it's worth doing some troubleshooting with the port itself. Give these steps a try.

items.title: Amazon is funding a new nuclear plant in Indiana
items.summary: Amazon has reached an agreement with X-energy and American Electric Power to build a nuclear energy plant in Indiana. The facility aims to generate nearly 1 gigawatt of carbon-free electricity on a decommissioned coal plant site.
items.blurb: Amazon has signed an agreement with X-energy and American Electric Power (AEP) to fund the building of a new nuclear energy facility in Indiana.
